title: Shout
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sleeping hearts are waking now
Fire rising from the ground
Every fear is breaking down
Your light is all around

Stomp our feet and shout it loud
We won't stop, we're running now
Till the night is fading out
Your praise will be our sound

[Pre-Chorus]
Lift your eyes
To the sky
On this rhythm
Faith comes alive

[Chorus]
Rise and shout
This is the moment
Cry it out
Let the earth hear

Running with You, Lord!
Hearts are beating
This is our worship
Starting right here

[Verse 2]
All the doubts are swept away
Hope is rising in this place
Every door is open wide
We are filled with faith

Standing strong we shout as one
Like a wave we're moving on
Your revival has begun
Your will be done

[Bridge]
Hey! Hey! Hey!

[Final Chorus]
Rise and shout
This is the moment
Cry it out
Let the earth hear

Running with You, Lord!
Hearts are beating
This is our worship
Starting right here

title: Oh What a Day
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The morning breaks, Your mercies new
Every heart is fixed on You
Rising up with songs of grace
As we seek Your holy face

[Verse 2]
Shake the dust, let shadows flee
Hands are lifted, we are free
From the youngest to the old
Watch the miracle unfold

[Pre-Chorus]
Lift your head and see the light
Burning through the darkest night
With one voice we make our stand
Kingdom come across the land!

[Chorus]
Oh what a day! Let the praises ring!
To the Savior, to the King!
Season of joy! Let the sound go loud!
Halle-Hallelujah, we're singing proud!
Lord of my soul~~ oh!
Jesus, my heart is full of thanks
Lift up the shout from all the ranks
Halle-Hallelujah!

[Verse 3]
Bound together in Your love
Blessed by Father from above
We are children of the Day
Walking in Your perfect Way

[Bridge]
Every breath, a miracle gift
To the Heavens, eyes we lift
Unstoppable, this holy fire
Jesus, You're our soul's desire!

[Chorus 2]
Oh what a day! Let the praises ring!
To the Savior, to the King!
Season of joy! Let the sound go loud!
Halle-Hallelujah, we're singing proud!
Lord of my soul~~
Jesus, my heart is full of thanks
Lift up the shout from all the ranks
Halle-Hallelujah!

[Big Finish Chorus]
Oh what a day! Praise to the One!
For the victory He has won!
Season of joy! Let the sound go loud!
Halle-Hallelujah, we're singing proud!
You are the Glory!
Jesus, my heart is full of thanks
Lift up the shout from all the ranks
Halle-Hallelujah!

Shout it out! Hey!
Lift Him high! Hey!
Praise the Lord forevermore!
Hallelujah! Amen!

title: I Will Sing to You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Here I stand before You now
With an open heart, I bow
Here I stand before You now
With an open heart, I bow
In the silence I hear Your voice
Calling me again

[Pre-Chorus]
A song that slept inside my soul
Now rises up to You

[Chorus]
I will sing to You, Lord
With all my heart I'll praise
You're my joy, my song forever
You alone I raise
I will pray to You, Lord
In every breath I take
Till the very end of my days
Your name I will proclaim

[Verse 2]
Looking back on all my days
I see mercy, I see grace
When my heart was overwhelmed
You gave me perfect peace

[Pre-Chorus]
Now a melody of thanks
Is rising up again

[Chorus]
I will sing to You, Lord
With all my heart I'll praise
You're my joy, my song forever
You alone I raise
I will pray to You, Lord
In every breath I take
Till the very end of my days
Your name I will proclaim

[Verse 3]
Through the passing of the years
Still Your love remains the same
Every step I take today
You pour out Your grace

[Pre-Chorus]
From the deepest part of me
This praise is overflowing

[Chorus]
I will sing to You, Lord
With all my heart I'll praise
You're my joy, my song forever
You alone I raise
I will pray to You, Lord
In every breath I take
Till the very end of my days
Your name I will proclaim

[Final Chorus]
I will sing to You, Lord (I will sing)
With all my heart I'll praise
You're my joy, my song forever (You alone)
You alone I raise

I will pray to You, Lord (forever)
In every breath I take
Till the very end of my days (You alone)
Your name I will proclaim

[Chorus]
I will sing to You, Lord (I will sing)
With all my heart I'll praise
You're my joy, my song forever (You alone)
You alone I raise

I will pray to You, Lord (forever)
In every breath I take
Till the very end of my days (You alone)
Your name I will proclaim

title: Lord Has Called My Name
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Through the barren night I walked,
Breathing slowly, standing still.
Then a quiet light appeared,
Lifting up my weary soul.

[Pre-Chorus]
When You reached Your hand to me,
I bowed low before Your grace.
Before fear could find my heart,
Love had already found me.

[Chorus]
You called my name with perfect love.
You never left when I fell down.
Even in my weakest hour,
Your faithful love remained with me.

[Verse 2]
When I could not see the end,
And my steps grew slow with doubt,
In the silence I still heard
Every promise You had made.

[Pre-Chorus]
When my heart was turning back,
Shaken more than I could bear,
Without a single word You came,
Holding me to walk again.

[Chorus]
You called my name with perfect love.
You became my light in darkness.
Even when my journey paused,
Your faithful hands were holding me.

[Bridge]
Every prayer too deep for words,
Every tear I could not hide,
You had known them from the start,
Answering with endless love.

[Chorus]
You called my name with perfect love.
You have never given up on me.
Though the years may come and go,
Your faithful love is here to stay.

[Final Chorus]
Love has brought me all this way;
Now I know the reason why.
With my life I'll sing Your praise.

I will live within Your love.
I will never turn away.
Though the years may come and go,
Your love will always be my song.

title: Parrhesia
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Male Solo 1]
Early dawn, the world is cold and gray
Heavy shoulders, starting one more day
Every burden, every cross I bear
Lord, I know You've heard my every prayer

[Verse 2 - Male Solo 2]
The weight of a name I cannot cast away
Tears I've hidden through the heat of day
When my feet are stumbling on the ground
In Your mercy, I am truly found

[Pre-Chorus - Male Duet]
I hear Your voice, calling me by name
I come to You, I'm stepping through the flame
By the power of the rugged Cross
I lift my eyes, no matter what the cost

[Chorus - Full 4-Part Harmony]
Parrhesia, before Your Throne I stand
Parrhesia, my victory's in Your hand
Though the world may shake, I will not fear
Your mighty hand is always holding me near
With boldness now, I take one more step

[Verse 3 - Male Quartet]
Walking with my brothers, side by side
In Your grace, we have nowhere to hide
More than titles, or a worldly crown
As Your saints, we're never bowing down

[Bridge - Call and Response]
A peace the world could never give
A promise where my soul can live
We know we'll never walk alone
You're leading us back home!

[Chorus - Grand Finale]
Parrhesia, before Your Throne I stand
Parrhesia, my victory's in Your hand
Though the world may shake, I will not fear
Your mighty hand is always holding me near
With boldness now, I take one more step

title: Faithful Still
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Long before my life began
You knew my name, You held my hand
Past my will, past every choice
Your love flowed in, I heard Your voice

[Pre-Chorus]
Through the dark and wandering night
Your hand was there, You were my light
Always faithful, always true

[Chorus 1]
Through it all, You're faithful
Always by my side
Jesus, Name so beautiful
Grateful for Your light

[Verse 2]
In every step, in every hour
Grace is here, my quiet tower
Constant love, a gift so free
Giving all the strength to me

[Pre-Chorus]
In the lonely, quiet night
You hold me close within Your sight
Always faithful, always true

[Chorus 2]
Through it all, You're faithful (So faithful)
Always by my side (Right by my side)
Jesus, Name so beautiful
Grateful for Your light

[Bridge]
Always there, You wait for me
Love that never lets me go
You're my song, my story
The only hope I know

[Chorus 3]
Through it all, You're faithful (So faithful)
Always by my side (Right by my side)
Jesus, Name so beautiful (Lift it high)
Grateful for Your light

[Chorus 4]
I love You, Lord, my Savior (I love You, Lord)
I praise You evermore (Forevermore)
Great is Your Name, oh Jesus (Lift it high)
Share Your love with all

title: All My Life
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Looking back on all my days
Thought I walked them on my own
But Your unseen hand was there
Guiding every step I'd take

Through the times I lost my way
Through the days I felt so weak
Even when I could not see
You were always there with me

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I stand here by Your grace
Led by Your faithful hand

[Chorus]
With a grateful heart I sing
You have led my life, O Lord
Through the darkest nights to now
You have carried me

With a grateful heart I stand
You're the reason that I live
All my life You have been near
It is all Your love

[Verse 2]
On the road so long and hard
When I almost gave it up
You restored my strength again
With Your gentle, loving hand

Even through my tears and pain
None of it was lived in vain
Every moment of my life
You were always there

[Bridge]
All my life is in Your hands
Every step is in Your plan
Now I trust in You alone
Only You, my Lord

[Chorus]
With a grateful heart I sing
You have led my life, O Lord
Through the darkest nights to now
You have carried me

With a grateful heart I stand
You're the reason that I live
All my life You have been near
It is all Your love

title: Every Breath
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Waking up to the morning light
The scent of home, a peaceful sight
I used to think it was just another day
But now I see Your grace in every way
Every breath I take is a gift from You

[Verse 2]
Golden sun through the window pane
Mercy falling like the summer rain
The mundane life turns into a song
In Your presence, Lord, is where I belong
Every step I take, I am filled with joy

[Pre-Chorus]
When the shadows try to hem me in
And the lonely nights begin to win
I see You walking there before me
I will rise in Your victory!

[Chorus]
All my days are held in Your grace
Shadows fade before Your radiant face
With a shout, I'll lift my praise to You
I will sing Your name my whole life through!

[Bridge]
Fear, get out! My God is here!
Despair, you're gone! The light is clear!
You know me better than I know myself
I trust Your heart and nothing else!

[Chorus - Climax]
All my days are held in Your grace (In Your grace!)
Shadows fade before Your radiant face
With a shout, I'll lift my praise to You (Praise to You!)
I will sing Your name my whole life through!

[Chorus]
All my days (All my days) are held in Your grace (Amen)
Shadows fade (They fade away) before Your radiant face
With a shout, I'll lift my praise to You (Jesus!)
I will sing Your name my whole life through!

Every moment is Yours, my King
Every heartbeat is an offering
Thank You, Jesus. My Lord.

title: Harmony of Praise
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Female Solo]
Your voice is whispering softly
Flowing deep within my heart
From the lowest place You call me
Your love draws me where You are

[Verse 2 - Male Solo]
Even on the shaking road
I will hold Your guiding hand
In the darkness You are shining
I will sing of who You are

[Pre-Chorus - Mixed Choir]
Every voice now joins together
We lift our hands and sing

[Chorus - Female Choir]
All together we will praise You
Heaven and earth proclaim
Like a river flowing onward
To the ocean of Your grace

[Chorus - Male Choir]
All together we will praise You
Harmony forever strong
Every breath and every heartbeat
Lifts Your holy name in song

[Bridge - Mixed Duet]
Your love is overflowing
Our song is reaching heaven

[Final Chorus - Mixed Choir]
All together we will praise You
All the world responds in song
Like a river flowing onward
To the ocean deep and strong
All together we will praise You
Glory rising endlessly
With our arms wide open
We lift Your name on high

Hallelujah

title: I Love You Lord
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the struggles of my life
You were always by my side
Even in the unseen moments
You were watching over me

When I fell and lost my strength
Still Your presence never left
You restored my weary soul
Gave me strength again

[Pre-Chorus]
Every step along the way
You have led me, Lord

[Chorus]
Thank You, Lord
For bringing me this far
By Your grace and endless love
You have carried me

I love You, Lord
You are my God
Every day of all my life
I give it all to You

[Verse 2]
Through the seasons filled with tears
You were always there with me
Even every little prayer
You have never turned away

When I walked through darkest nights
You became my guiding light
Even now You lead my life
Faithfully each day

[Pre-Chorus]
Looking back I clearly see
It was always love

[Chorus]
Thank You, Lord
For bringing me this far
By Your grace and endless love
You have carried me

I love You, Lord
You are my God
Every day of all my life
I give it all to You

[Bridge]
You alone are now my way
You alone are all my strength
You alone are all my song
I will praise You endlessly

You alone are all my hope
You alone are now my light
With my every breath and life
I will worship You

[Final Chorus]
Thank You, Lord
You are my salvation
Every moment of my life
I give it all to You

I love You, Lord
You are my God
Forever I will sing
All my praise to You

title: Miracle of Grace
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I had nothing to bring, no crown to my name
Just a heart prone to wander, lost in the shame
But You stepped in my darkness, You called out my name
With arms wide open, You washed all my pain

[Verse 2]
I was worn by the world, so heavy and low
In the depths of my failure, with nowhere to go
You found me in silence, You reached for my hand
By the power of mercy, You helped me to stand

[Chorus]
It's a miracle, just to know Your love
A song breaking through where the desert was
It's a miracle, that I can believe
That Your grace is the only thing I'll ever need
Oh, what a gift today, it's a miracle

[Bridge]
I lift my eyes and I see it now
Your love is written in the stars above
From the fields of green to the highest sky
Even for someone as broken as I... (You are there)

[Chorus 2]
It is love, Lord, You called my name
Rescued my soul from the guilt and the shame
It's a miracle, walking hand in hand
Without Your love, I could never stand
Oh, what a gift today, it is love

[Chorus 3]
It's a miracle! Let the earth cry out (Praise His name)
The beauty of Heav'n is all around
It's a miracle (Such a miracle) to trust in You
Only Your love could make all things new
Oh, what a gift today, it is love

Every breath, every moment, a miracle
Thank You, my Jesus, my All
Na-na-na-na

title: My Voice
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I fold my hands and close my eyes so tight
Giving my small heart to You, the source of light
In this quiet moment, feeling You so near
Thank You, loving God, for being with us here

[Chorus]
The Lord is living deep inside my heart
He hears my voice, even when we're apart
Like a gentle breeze, He touches my soul
Always by our side, making us whole

[Verse 2]
With a pretty heart, I sing a song of praise
Following Your steps for all of my days
You called us to be the light of the world
I love You, precious Lord, more than any gold

[Chorus]
The Lord is living deep inside my heart
He hears my voice, even when we're apart
Like a gentle breeze, He touches my soul
Always by our side, making us whole

Lord, I love You with all I am
In Jesus' name we pray
Amen

title: Lord You're My Way
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the quiet of this dawn
I come before You, Lord
With this small and simple faith
I give my heart to You

[Chorus]
Lord, You are my strength
Lord, You are my way
Yesterday and still today
I walk with You always

[Verse 2]
With a weary heart I come
Calling on Your name
Even all my tearful prayers
You have always heard

[Chorus]
Lord, You are my strength
Lord, You are my way
Yesterday and still today
I walk with You always

[Bridge]
Your grace will never change
Your love will always stay

[Final Chorus]
Lord, You are my strength
Lord, You are my way
Yesterday and still today
I walk with You always

title: Our Worship
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sunday morning, bright and shining light
With a heart so full, we come today
All the love You've planned for me to see
Waiting for Your grace, I'm on my way

[Verse 2]
All the busy thoughts inside my mind
Fold them neatly, put them all away
In Your holy Word so deep and pure
I will dive into Your love to stay

[Chorus]
Lord, please accept our worship now
With our precious songs, we lift You high
Heaven's glory, pouring down on us
Filling us with joy, our hearts arise

Looking only to our Loving Lord
With my whole heart, all I give to You
Everywhere and always by our side
Worshiping the God, the Highest One

Lord, we love You so
Please accept our praise

title: Wake Up
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Light is shining in the dark
Hope is glowing in our hearts
Hear the joyful news today
Jesus came, He made a way

[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody stand up now
Lift your hands and shout it loud

[Chorus]
Wake up, wake up, sing it out
Jump and turn around
It's the day that Jesus came
Sing it loud
Clap your hands and celebrate
Praise His holy name

[Verse 2]
Stars were shining in the night
Angels filled the sky with light
All the world is full of joy
Welcome to the Savior born

[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody stand up now
Sing it loud and shout it out

[Chorus]
Wake up, wake up, sing it out
Jump and turn around
It's the day that Jesus came
Sing it loud
Clap your hands and celebrate
Praise His holy name

[Bridge]
Jump up high, jump up high
Lift your hands up to the sky
All the world will sing today
Jesus is the way

[Final Chorus]
Wake up, wake up, sing it out
Jump and turn around
It's the day that Jesus came
Sing it loud
Clap your hands and celebrate
Praise His holy name
